{"consolidated_memory":"**Dropped frames in realtime/ws/session.ts — Two separate incidents**

File: realtime/ws/session.ts (TypeScript, realtime side)
Problem: Dropped frames in websocket session (frames missing from client sequence)
Reproduction: Hold a socket open through a network flap
Covering test: realtime/ws/session.test.ts

**Incident 1: Midnight boundary jobs [2026-02-06]**
- Manifestation: Dropped frames only for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR: #9125, branch fix/dropped-frames-1
- Outcome: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 70 days running

**Incident 2: Negative UTC offset users [2026-05-18]**
- Manifestation: Dropped frames only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR: #9222, branch fix/dropped-frames-2
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 5.7 s to 372 ms"}
